issue.title: Seeded gpt-5.5 is enabled although Codex refuses it for ChatGPT-account logins (model_not_found)
issue.body:
Found on 2026-10-27 while verifying effort names with real turns through the product's bundled Codex CLI (0.160.0), logged in with the owner's ChatGPT account.

## What happens

Every turn on `gpt-5.5`, at any effort, is refused by the provider before any work: HTTP 400 `invalid_request_error`, code `model_not_found`, message "The 'gpt-5.5' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account." The seeded model catalog offers `gpt-5.5` as an enabled Codex model, so a loop can select it and will fail on every turn with a pinned refusal.

## Expected

Either the seed does not enable `gpt-5.5` by default for ChatGPT-account logins (preflight knows the authentication source), or the catalog or guide says plainly that `gpt-5.5` needs an API-key login. A turn that fails this way should also be easy to recognise in the run record as "model not available for this account" rather than a generic argument refusal.

## Evidence

Two real turns on 2026-10-28 04:11 UTC (`gpt-5.5` at `none` and at `minimal`), same refusal both times; `gpt-6-luna` at `none` completed in the same session.


## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

D171 resolves refinement through explicit account/endpoint guidance and a disposable structured-refusal public proof. Static catalogue metadata is not current entitlement. A docs-only disposition requires actual recognition QA; correct a narrow proven diagnostic gap if necessary. No automatic model substitution, global seed disable or unsupported API-key-only claim.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_427_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.
